launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91579&key=user_uploads/978619/4443ca80-d250-46a5-8234-98a9d5852a59)

Hey 👋, we’re Haz and Wyatt, the founders of Pally.

We’re building Pally because in a world full of ‘AI SDRs’, our warm connections become more important than ever… Yet today, keeping track of thousands of connections across countless social platforms is impossible. 

We forget to respond, we miss important moments, and we lose touch.

We’re building Pally to solve that.

If this resonates, we’d love your early feedback. Download Pally here: [www.pally.com](http://www.pally.com)

# Demo

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g97sd_roD14

## How does it work?

We bring together all your connections, across all your socials (inc. iMessage, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Google, Email, Calendar, and X), and then our AI researches everything they’ve ever posted online.

Pally uses this deep understanding of each relationship to help you:

* Prepare you for meetings
* Stay in touch with your potential customers/hires/investors (or just remind you to ring your mum from time to time)
* Search over your network to find the right person for any query (”who do I know in New York that I’ve not spoken to in a while?”)
* Add people to pipelines

We also added some fun relationship stats, so you can see how social you are compared to other Pally users, how each relationship is growing/declining over time, how long you take to reply vs how long others take to reply to you, and more.

## Who’s it for?

We’re mostly focused on founders and investors, but we’ve also seen salespeople, recruiters, agency owners, and creators get a lot of value from Pally; essentially anyone in a role where relationships are a primary focus (and honestly, we believe in the world of AI, that’s _everyone_).

## What's next?

We're excited to launch this into public beta today, learn from what our users are loving, and where they’re wanting more, and build that. 

Our roadmap includes adding integrations with AI meeting note takers, so all your relationship context is in one place, adding an iOS app so you have all your data on the go, and adding more agentic capabilities.

# Ask

Please upvote us here and on [Product Hunt](https://www.producthunt.com/products/pally-ai-relationship-management), and give Pally a test and let us know how you get on! 

We’re also hiring! If you’re interested in working with us, please email [hiring@pally.com](mailto:hiring@pally.com) with your cv.

Thanks for your support,

Haz + Wyatt 🫶

launches.title: Logical: The Proactive Desktop Copilot
launches.tagline: Logical makes every knowledge worker 5x productive
launches.body:
Hi everyone,

We’re [Sam](http://linkedin.com/in/samurdhilbk) and [Anushka](http://linkedin.com/in/anushkaidamekorala/), co-founders of [Logical](https://trylogical.ai).

**Logical is a copilot that lives on your desktop and proactively assists with things like drafting emails, meeting insights and tracking to-do items.**

Instead of waiting for you to prompt, Logical suggests context-aware actions in many common apps and services. It’s like Clippy, but actually good.

https://youtu.be/XfyPZb14LZM?si=aaJMF37-ipwkJBDV

### Problem

Prompt-first AI is fundamentally flawed. We waste hours every week writing lengthy prompts, context-switching and copy-pasting to get a chatbot to understand what we're doing. The context surrounding our work (emails, meeting notes, knowledge bases etc.) lives in siloed services that don't talk to each other. A truly helpful AI must live where we work: on the desktop.

### Solution

Logical lives on your desktop, observing your work to build an understanding of your intent and the context that surrounds it. As you switch between apps and tabs, Logical transfers that context with you.

It proactively suggests actions based on what you're doing—whether you're in Gmail, Slack, or Excel. This turns Logical into an all-in-one assistant: it's your email drafter, to-do manager, AI note-taker, and chatbot, all combined.

launches.title: JSX Tool: In-Browser React IDE
launches.tagline: The AI first IDE for React development
launches.body:
**tl;dr**

JSX Tool is an in-browser IDE that creates a common language between developers and AI for building React UIs. Click any element in the browser to jump straight to the relevant line of code and edit it yourself, or provide precise context to an LLM to make updates.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JIIXvN7vhrs

---

---

---

**The Problem**

LLMs have transformed how we write code, yet they consistently struggle with precise UI updates. The common belief is that AI simply doesn’t do well with visual tasks, but the real problem is that we're asking LLMs to understand UI without giving them proper context. They’re great at vibe styling but not great at producing precise UIs.

When you prompt an LLM about styling or component changes today, you're describing visual elements through text alone. It's like giving directions without a map. Meanwhile, developers juggle between browser DevTools, their code editor, screenshot tools, and component explorers just to gather enough context to make AI useful for these kinds of tasks.

**Our Solution**

JSX Tool addresses this by letting you click on any element and prompt your LLM with precise DOM context, the exact source component, its styles, and its position in the React hierarchy. Everything happens in one place: inspect, prompt, edit, and see changes instantly. 

And when AI suggestions aren't quite right, our full IDE is right there in the browser with that same context, so you can jump to the exact line of code you want to edit with a single click. You get the benefits of AI, while keeping the creative control and the nuanced decision-making that UI development demands.

Now developers and AI models share a common language for UI; both can reference the exact same visual elements with clarity, turning LLMs from guessing machines into powerful UI collaborators.

**@Tagging:** In your prompts, you can either type @ and click on a section of your webpage to reference another element relative to the one you’re focused on OR you can type @/ to mention files and directories you want the LLM to have as context in your prompt.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95312&key=user_uploads/3082625/2b76e7e0-6efc-4bb5-8b16-86f1cffd6f08)

**CSS Editor:** JSX Tool has a CSS editor that is nearly as feature-complete as the native CSS style editors found in browser element inspectors. Instead of applying your changes to a single element, you can see how your change to a line of JSX code would be applied globally.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95312&key=user_uploads/3082625/f911aeb0-3a85-4e30-9042-d49fd4a06d61)

**LSP Integrations:** JSX Tool ships with a lightweight IDE for manually editing code, but still an IDE that does some heavy lifting. The JSX Tool IDE integrates in language servers for common React development tasks, so you can have things like type-checking, auto-complete, and linting upon save. We currently ship with LSPs for Typescript, Tailwind, ESLint, and Prettier.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95312&key=user_uploads/3082625/57a590b7-b2c0-41e1-90c3-336c839b7219)

To learn more or start using the extension, go to [jsxtool.com](https://jsxtool.com)!

_Note: IDE features are currently in app review and will be available in our next release._

**Team**

Jamie and Dan grew up in New York City and have been working on projects together for nearly 20 years. Before JSX Tool, we most recently built a mobile app for bypassing news site paywalls.

Jamie is a second-time YC founder. Prior to starting JSX Tool, he worked as a Software Engineer at YCombinator on their investor software. He previously co-founded Cheqout, a restaurant technology company that was a part of the YC W21 batch. Prior to his first startup, Jamie worked on Airbnb's China Risk Team.

Jamie has had a deep interest in higher-order and visual programming for a while. He previously built a version control system to diff and merge structured, non-textual assets. Many of the technical problems encountered in that project were very similar to those encountered in JSX Tool.

Dan worked most recently as a Senior Software Engineer at Everblue, where he led engineering teams building workflow applications to power US government systems. Prior to that, he worked as a Senior Cloud Engineer at Sela US. He got his start in tech in the world of React and has since returned to his roots. In a former life, he was a Chef at a James Beard award-winning restaurant.

launches.body:
We're Ian and Ben, co-founders of WithAI. WithAI helps institutional investors use AI to research stocks and manage their portfolios. We forward-deploy to set up Multiplier, a secure platform that teaches AI how the fund works and connects it to all the needed tools, files, data, and context, so that investors can use the full strength of today's agents without taking on a second job as Claude-wrangler. After three months, we're live with multiple clients, doing >$100k ARR. If you know a fundamental equity investor, we'd love to meet them. Email [ian@withai.co](mailto:ian@withai.co).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S_ZhD9Y60GQ>

AI has radically transformed coding. But in finance, super-sharp, highly-paid people are spending 2026 combing through an inbox full of PDFs, updating models in Excel, and eyeballing Bloomberg charts. Multiplier packages everything necessary to change that! It includes secure inference endpoints, changelogs, ontology maintainance, guardrails, and VM infrastructure, and it's all hosted on client servers. With a mix of open-source protocols and WithAI elbow grease, Multiplier connects to all the research, tools, and data used at a given firm. We conduct face-to-face interviews so we can give AI the tacit knowledge it needs to work at _your fund specifically_; gaps get filled by user feedback to the AI. Our interface––more like an IDE than a collection of chatboxes––makes oversight, guidance, and participation natural. Early clients have called Multiplier "a tremendous proprietary knowledge flywheel" and "hugely insightful, a massive force multiplier." (In fact, that's where we got the name.) 

Ben and Ian became fast friends building a deeptech investment group together (still going strong) and reunited because they'd independently hit on this idea. Ben, working on enterprise AI as founding researcher at Sentient Labs, saw what stopped his clients from accelerating like his engineers and wanted to productize the solution for the industry he knew best––investing. launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Mentlio is the engineering intelligence platform for the AI-coding era. We help engineering organizations cut AI costs by up to 30% and finally see what ROI that spend is actually producing. All without ever collecting your prompts or source code.

**Launch Video**

<https://youtu.be/-28j9HvTYV0>

**Problem**

Every engineering org is now an AI org. Token usage is growing exponentially, and so is the bill. The following questions have been largely unanswered:

* How can we cut our usage-based AI spend without bottlenecking usage or efficiency?
* What ROI are we getting for every dollar of AI spend?
* To what extent is AI-generated code creating quality debt?

Brian Armstrong recently laid out how Coinbase is reducing AI spend while token usage grows exponentially on X: better defaults, smarter routing, cache awareness, lean context, and full visibility into usage and impact. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=111055&key=user_uploads/2693539/7bf48740-dd37-4015-9da9-ec0f9bd900ed)

Coinbase built a custom harness, LLM gateway, routing, and usage visibility internally. We believe they have the right thesis, but most engineering orgs don’t want to run on a custom harness. **Mentlio gives every eng team a better version of those savings & visibility without changing any workflows.**

**Solution**

Mentlio gives you:

1. **ROI.** We translate every PR into normalized units of work: Delivery Points. We consider associated spend, code reusability, and historical patches to turn "we spend $X on AI"  -> "we spend $X per impact point.” compared to industry data. 
2. **Cost intelligence + optimization.** See exactly where AI spend goes across teams, tools, and models. Optionally catch and cut waste across cache misses, oversized models on trivial tasks, bloated context and cut it without capping/bottlenecking accuracy. 
3. **Quality signal.** AI-assisted code that ships fast but breaks later isn't a win. We connect AI usage to delivery and quality outcomes so you can see the full picture

We’re the only platform with the above capabilities that never collects prompts or source code.

**Our Asks**

If you are or know a Head of Eng, VP Eng, CTO, or platform lead at a 15+ engineer org with real AI spend, reach out! You can book a demo at[ mentlio.com/intro](http://mentlio.com/intro) or reach us at [founders@mentlio.com](mailto:founders@mentlio.com).

**The Team**

Ashank and Ahmet met while studying Computer Science at Caltech while they were working part-time Founding Engineer roles at Series A and Seed stage startups. Ashank previously researched generative image AI & graph deep learning for pathology, genomics, and drug design at Dartmouth & Purdue and won internationally at the International Science & Engineering Fair & Junior Science & Humanities Symposium. Ahmet previously published his research in transformers and AI in IEEE, BMC AI, and ACM and also won internationally at the National AI Olympiad, International Science & Engineering Fair, and was named a Top 300 Science Scholar by Regeneron.

name: Moonshot
long_description:
We want to bring AI agents to a billion people.

To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector.

Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life.

For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot.

Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable.

Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf.

Take life personally.

The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail.

Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team.

Let's make it a Moonshot.

launches.title: Touchy 🙌: Voice-first AI Assistant for iPhone that understands the world around you
launches.tagline: Your personal AI assistant that sees what you see, remembers what matters to you, and gets things done across all your tools. Just ask out loud.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We’re building Touchy 🙌, a voice and image-first AI assistant for the iPhone that personalizes itself to you. You can activate Touchy from your lock screen to instantly get things done across your apps or get answers about the world around you. Touchy is free to try, get it here: <https://apps.apple.com/us/app/touchy-ai-at-your-fingertips/id6798889392>

<https://youtube.com/shorts/IJNucvAZ_-k>

## **The Problem**

You probably know the feeling:

You ask the assistant on your phone, across the room, to send a colleague a message.

It cheerfully replies that it found 10 search results for “text Bob on Slack”.

So you trudge to your phone, find the app, open the DM, and begrudgingly type out your message instead.

We wanted a better personal assistant, one that had the intelligence and integrations we’ve come to expect from our AI agents, with the convenience of one that was native to your devices. We also believe that for AI to truly be personal, it needs to be deeply integrated into your life and the world around you. Right now, AI systems are constrained largely to using digital tools, yet the physical world is rich with audio and visual information that your phone is capable of receiving.

## What We Built

So we built Touchy. One button press and you're instantly talking to an assistant that can see what you see, remember what you've said, and take action across all the tools you use. 

What sets Touchy apart:

* **Reimagined UX.** Touchy is a fast, fully iOS-native app with a unique interface that is delightful to use and brings it closer to the world around you.
* **Sees and hears the world around you**. Speak to Touchy and it can speak back. Easily snap a photo with the app’s camera to give Touchy access to what you’re seeing.
* **Gets things done across your apps**. Touchy comes with built-in integrations with 1,000+ popular apps, as well as iOS-native capabilities such as you contacts and location.
* **Make it yours over time**. You chat with Touchy in a single, continuous conversation. It automatically collects memories and preferences, and tailors itself to be more useful to you as you use it.

It's built to give you your attention back. Ask it something, let it act, and get back to your day — no app fighting for your attention.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=111407&key=user_uploads/3697324/23ce7916-fce5-44c4-9ebf-f04049fee639)

## The team

We’re Rohit, Andrew, and Kev. Before this, Rohit was doing a PhD on AI alignment at Google DeepMind Princeton and graduated #1 in Berkeley EECS. Andrew built educational software that scaled to half a million students worldwide. Kev was a startup founding engineer, developing data and GPU infrastructure that power many of the leading AI neolabs today. 

We met during undergrad at UC Berkeley, and we’re coming back together to research, productionize, and scale the future of personal technology.

## Our ask

If you have an iPhone, download Touchy and try it out: <https://apps.apple.com/us/app/touchy-ai-at-your-fingertips/id6798889392>

We would love to learn what people find themselves using Touchy for, and what they wish they could use it for. You can also report bugs by shaking your phone or just telling Touchy. You can also reach us at [founders@touchyapp.com](mailto:founders@touchyapp.com)

name: Sentient OS
long_description:
Nobody's built truly proactive AI, because it requires running inference on your entire life. In the cloud, that's insanely expensive and a privacy nightmare. But not on your own chip.

Every night, Sentient's on-device LLM wakes your Mac and understands what's new in your life (email, messages, files, Granola transcripts...), entirely locally, and distills it into a knowledge base.

You wake up to your work already prepared: the reply you forgot, drafted from your own context; the subscription you never use renewing tomorrow, caught; the report you promised in the group chat, ready to send. Everything is one click from firing through computer use, and nothing fires until you click.

Or click your Mac notch anytime and say "finish this for me." Sidekick takes over the thing you were doing with its own cursor while you move on.

On-device inference at this scale was supposed to be impossible: devices too slow, and models too dumb. So we built the stack ourselves: a custom LiteRT-LM fork (KV-cache reuse, speculative decoding, custom k-quants) that runs nightly on 8 GB Macs. The user's hardware does ~90% of the compute, and their own ChatGPT or Claude subscription does the rest, so our marginal cost is ~$0, and our servers store nothing.

Our alpha soft-launch was top post of the month on r/macapps (688 upvotes), and we launched to 4000+ users in our first week with $0 marketing. We're free and open source for consumers; the same engine on the work stack (Slack, Granola, Linear, Notion) is the enterprise business.

Sentient OS raised ~$1M in pre-seed, backed by YC, Afore, and the a16z Speedrun scout fund.
one_liner: On-device AI that knows your entire life and does your work overnight.
